queue.claim: Upper eyelid crease height above the margin is ~8-11 mm in Western women and ~6-8 mm in men; in East Asians it is absent or low (3-6 mm). Normal MRD1 is 4-5 mm and MRD2 5-5.5 mm.
queue.query: upper eyelid crease height mm normal women men Asian Caucasian MRD1 normal values

queue.claim: The globe centre sits ~1-2 mm superolateral to the orbital aperture centre (Stephan & Davidson 2008), and the corneal apex lies within a few mm of the mid-supraorbital to mid-infraorbital tangent.
queue.query: Stephan Davidson placement of the human eyeball and canthi in craniofacial identification
